title: Quick Gooey Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A sweet and gooey Norwegian dish featuring brunost cheese, perfect for a weeknight dinner or meal prep, and friendly to diabetic diets due to its balanced ingredients and portion control.

ingredients.name: Brunost cheese
ingredients.notes: or substitute with sweet cheese alternative

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, and salt until well combined.
Add the shredded brunost cheese to the bowl and mix until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix the cooked pasta and chopped walnuts if using.
Add the pasta mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until the pasta is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and dot the top with unsalted butter.
Sprinkle a pinch of ground cinnamon over the top of the casserole.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
